name: 血之鞭击
description: 对全部正方向3格内的敌人造成1倍伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var directions = [{x:1,y:0},{x:-1,y:0},{x:0,y:1},{x:0,y:-1}]; var targets = []; var seen = {}; for (var d = 0; d < directions.length; d++) { for (var distance = 1; distance <= 3; distance++) { var x = caster.x + directions[d].x * distance; var y = caster.y + directions[d].y * distance; for (var i = 0; i < battle.pieces.length; i++) { var piece = battle.pieces[i]; if (piece.currentHp <= 0 || piece.x !== x || piece.y !== y || arePlayersAllied(battle, piece.ownerPlayerId, caster.ownerPlayerId) || seen[piece.instanceId]) continue; seen[piece.instanceId] = true; targets.push(piece); } } } var damage = Math.floor(caster.attack * context.skill.powerMultiplier); for (var t = 0; t < targets.length; t++) { var target = targets[t]; if (target.currentHp > 0) flow.effects.damage(caster, target.instanceId, damage, 'physical', context.skill.id); } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '挥出血之鞭击，命中' + targets.length + '名敌人' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { return { description: skillDef.description, expectedValues: { damage: Math.floor((piece.attack || 0) * skillDef.powerMultiplier), range: 3 } }; }
